feedback: Remove the ~1994 people figure and the wind line. Neither is in the building data, so you gave the crew invented numbers. Say that the headcount above floor 36 is unknown, and that people may still be up there, as the caller said.

Add severity near the top: black smoke from floor 36 windows, alarm sounding, and occupants possibly still on the upper floors. You also missed the freight elevator on record, and you named no tenant on 36. The tenant is CME Group, with 16 people.

Don't say standpipe and FDC locations are not known when the record has no standpipe data at all. Write 'no standpipe/FDC data on file'. Drop the 'Reply MORE' line and use the space for the facts crews need first.
